description: Fallback quote-loop profile when no locale-specific profile exists. Copy to locales/<country>.json and fill in to add a locale.

language.name: English
language.notes: Use the seller's language when it is known. 2-5 lines per message.

phone.to_international: Use E.164 digits without '+' for WhatsApp chat IDs.

find: chat widget or contact form on the site
a wa.me/<number> link on the site

channel_order.notes: Give the user a call script; the agent does not phone.

business_hours.notes: Assumed Mon-Fri office hours in the seller's timezone.

search.notes: Add a country-code site: filter when the seller country is known.

vendor_identification.notes: Generic channels for the vendor-identification skill. Fill in the country-specific names when adding a locale.

web_search.ladder_notes: Swap the commercial word in this order when results are thin; use 'manufacturer' or 'made to order' for custom jobs. Use the local language when it is not English.
web_search.engine_notes: If the built-in web search ignores site: or is region-biased, run the query in Google in a real browser or a semantic search API.

aggregators.name: <main local price aggregator, if known>
aggregators.notes: Model pages listing every vendor; e.g. idealo (DE), PriceRunner (UK, Nordics), Google Shopping as a fallback.

directories.name: Yelp-style local directories
directories.notes: Yelp, the national yellow pages, trade association member lists; query with the trade noun plus city.

maps.notes: For showrooms and workshops near the user's city.

importer_lookup.notes: Or the brand's 'where to buy' / dealer locator page.

warnings: Flag multi-category marketplace storefronts and dropshippers for seller-shortlist to exclude.

reputable_signals: company registration number and physical address on the site
aggregator_signals: listing text identical to another storefront
ships from a third country with long lead times (dropshipping)

first_contact:
Hello, I'm looking for <product> for <one-line use case>, budget around <amount>.
What would you recommend? I'm considering <model>. Is it in stock, new and sealed?
What would delivery to <city> cost, and how long? Thanks!

Hi, is <model> (or something similar for <use>) in stock? New, not display stock?
Price including delivery to <city>, please. Thank you.
chase: Hello again, just following up on my question about <model>. Thanks!
holding_reply: Thank you! I'll get back to you about ordering.
templates.notes: Vary the wording for every seller.

cultural_notes: A seller's pre-sale answer previews its after-sale service: grade responsiveness and straightness, not only price.
Check the seller's return terms before treating a purchase as reversible.
